name: Mt Moriah
overview: Mt Moriah is the sacred location where God tested Abraham's faith by commanding him to offer his beloved son Isaac as a burnt offering, demonstrating profound trust and obedience (Genesis 22:1-2). Abraham journeyed to this mountain, seeing the place from afar on the third day (Genesis 22:4), where God ultimately provided a substitute, leading Abraham to name the site Jehovahjireh, meaning 'The Lord will see' or 'provide' (Genesis 22:14). This event reveals God's provision and faithfulness, pointing forward to Christ's ultimate sacrifice and God's redemptive plan.
